summary: Trivial __thiscall UI state toggle: computes result = 1 - this[0x1148], stores it back to this[0x1148], and returns the new value. Flips the integer field at offset 0x1148 between 0 and 1 on every call. No guards, globals, or callees.

local_names.result: new value written to this[0x1148], also the return value

operations.description: result = 1 - this[0x1148]; compute the complement of the current state field
this[0x1148] = result; write the new boolean state back to the field
return result; yield the new state value to the caller
